remarks: Welcome Home! Step back in time at Millstone Cottage, a beautifully preserved antique Colonial rich with charm, character, and local history. Set on a picturesque and manageable 0.26-acre property, this special residence is believed to date to the late 1700s and has served many chapters through the years before becoming the warm and inviting home it is today. Thoughtfully maintained and embracing its historic roots, the home offers comfortable everyday living paired with the architectural details and timeless appeal that make antique homes so beloved-plus the comfort of central air conditioning, a rare and highly appreciated feature in a home of this era. Flexible living spaces include 2-3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, allowing room for guests, work-from-home flexibility, or changing needs. The unfinished lower level provides abundant storage, while the detached two-car garage offers additional room for vehicles, hobbies, and seasonal items. Enjoy simple outdoor living and the rare opportunity to experience the warmth, craftsmanship, and story of a truly special Wilton home. Welcome Home!
